headline: Proceed with a controlled regional-first multilingual OTT launch.
positioning: Character-driven supernatural action with emotion, friendship and folklore-adjacent themes.
campaign: Test Hindi and Tamil trailer variants
Partner with anime and gaming creators
Run fan screenings in Mumbai, Bengaluru and Delhi
Increase campaign investment only after engagement validation

risks.mitigation: Start with metro-focused creator partnerships and expand on validated engagement.
Treat West Bengal as a later-phase market; collect Bengali trailer feedback first.
Dub Hindi first; keep Tamil and Telugu as subtitles until demand is proven.

items.decision: Release with a Hindi dub and Tamil/Telugu subtitles.
items.expected_benefit: Expected score uplift in Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu and Telangana outweighs the added localization cost.
evidence: Scenario lab: regional dub vs. Hindi subtitles
items.principal_risk: Dubbing cost may not be recovered if engagement is below forecast.

items.expected_benefit: Every top-five state prefers OTT; theatrical shows a lower score and higher cost.
items.principal_risk: OTT platform commitments are not yet contracted.

items.expected_benefit: Seasonality is neutral and avoids examination periods.
